summary: Every course must be letter graded. The minor is 20 units of graduate-level ENERGY lecture courses (numbered 200 and above), including ENERGY 201A, 201B, 201C and one of ENERGY 297 or 221. Research, teaching, directed reading and seminar units do not count. Your advisor checks that the rest are lecture courses, and that all were taken at Stanford.

program.why: Grading: "All required courses must be taken for a letter grade."

jNShQnis.why: "a student must take 20 units of graduate-level lecture courses in the department. These courses must include [ENERGY 201A, 201B, 201C, and 297 or 221]. The remaining courses may be any ENERGY graduate-level course." Graduate-level is read as numbered 200 and above (the catalog lists every ENERGY course from 200 up as graduate career). Research, teaching, directed reading, industry-training reports, TGR and the courses titled as seminars are not lecture courses, so they are left out; any other seminar is checked by hand.
